summary: Backend testing of MindSphere recipe feature (cook-along detail + custom recipe wizard + cookbook save/list/delete) plus targeted regressions for Gemini key reload, /api/diet/plan, and demo login. 16/16 tests passed in 14.4s.

TestAuthRegression: test_login_demo_works -> 200, valid token, user email matches
test_voice_config_gemini_loaded -> 200, model present, available=true (confirms new GEMINI_API_KEY loaded)
TestRecipeDetail: POST /diet/recipe/detail -> 200, returns full cook-along (name, ingredients[], steps[], nutrition{calories,protein,carbs,fat}, mental_health_benefit), no mongo _id leak
Repeat call with same meal_name returns SAME id -> cache works per user+meal
TestRecipeCustom: POST /diet/recipe/custom with wizard inputs (cuisine/dietary/available_ingredients/prep_time/calorie_target/mood_goal) -> 200, source='custom', saved=true, inputs echoed back, has id
TestCookbookList: GET /diet/recipes -> 200, list returns only saved=true items, custom recipe auto-appears, sorted newest-first by created_at
TestSaveRecipe: Create ai_plan recipe (not in cookbook), POST /diet/recipes/{id}/save -> 200 saved=true, now appears in cookbook

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1801 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, diet, recipes, exercise, voice, etc.) for maintainability (>700-line threshold).

Recipe cache uses {user_id, name, source:'ai_plan'} but name comes from LLM-generated meal title which can vary in casing/whitespace across diet plan regenerations — consider normalizing (lower/trim) before keying to avoid duplicate cached docs.
_parse_llm_json silently falls back to _fallback_recipe on parse failure with no logging — add a warning log so silent fallback rate is observable in production.
POST /diet/recipe/custom does NOT validate that any wizard field is non-empty; an entirely empty payload still triggers a full LLM call. Consider 422 if all primary fields blank to avoid cost/abuse.
GET /diet/recipes pagination is hard-capped at to_list(length=100) with no offset/limit query params — fine for MVP but flag for scaling.
Allergies are passed verbatim into the LLM prompt; consider also doing a post-generation ingredient scan to enforce the constraint server-side for safety.
seed_data_creation: Test created 2 ai_plan recipes (via cache + new) and 1 custom recipe under the demo user; the custom + one ai_plan were deleted at end of run. One ai_plan recipe (from the diet-plan meal) remains cached for the demo user — this is expected (cache behavior under test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All recipe endpoints + Gemini key + diet/plan + auth regression are green. The Gemini key reload was confirmed via /api/voice/config -> available=true. Recipe cache key currently is (user_id, raw meal_name, source='ai_plan') — if meal_name normalization changes, cache test may need update. Custom recipes are auto-saved (saved=true) and immediately listed; ai_plan recipes require explicit /save call to appear in cookbook. No frontend testing was performed (skipped per request).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
